title: Mandelson tried to influence Starmer’s cabinet reshuffle, new documents reveal – as it happened
summary_full: This blog is now closed, you can read more on this story hereThe Liberal Democrats are saying the UK needs a proper plan for immigration. This is from the party’s asylum and immigration spokesperson, Paul Kohler.Britain needs to regain control of its immigration system after the chaos of Brexit. Yet sixteen years after David Cameron’s ‘tens of thousands’ pledge, six prime ministers and ten home secretaries have overseen wild swings in immigration numbers with net migration now set to fall below zero.Britain faces serious demographic and economic challenges, and urgently needs a proper immigration plan to support our economy and public services.The fall in net migration is mainly a result of changes made by the previous Conservative government. We now need to go even further with a legally binding annual cap, set by parliament, at a far lower level.British and European people are leaving in their droves because of Labour’s high taxes whilst non-EU immigration remains far too high. British families are left to pay for it with lower wages, longer waits for a GP appointment and homes they cannot afford. Mass low-skilled immigration must end completely as it is bad for our economy and corrosive to our society. Continue reading...
